extra.message: The 404 error handler builds a Jinja2 template by interpolating request.url into the template source using Python %-formatting and then passes the result to render_template_string. Because request.url is attacker-controlled (the URL of the 404 request) and render_template_string evaluates Jinja2 expressions, a crafted URL containing '{{...}}' or '{%...%}' directives (e.g., {{config.SECRET_KEY_HMAC}}, {{config}}) is evaluated, leaking server secrets / enabling RCE. The unsanitized URL is also rendered as raw HTML, enabling reflected XSS.

cwe: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')

extra.message: The /search exception handler builds a Jinja2 template by interpolating str(e) (the exception message) into the template source with %-formatting and then calls render_template_string. Because the exception message can be derived from user input (e.g., a malformed SQL string from the injection above, a parser error, etc.), and render_template_string evaluates Jinja2 expressions, an attacker can craft input that causes an exception containing template directives, which are then evaluated — leading to SSTI / RCE. The unescaped error is also reflected into HTML (XSS / CWE-209).
